crossRefs.note: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…

translations.web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
translations.bsb: to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
translations.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
translations.asv: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner's tongue.
